changes_made.explanation: This paper is about LLM quantization/inference optimization, not natural language generation. It benchmarks quantization methods on language modeling perplexity and downstream task accuracy, but does not generate or evaluate NLG outputs.
Normalized capitalization of metrics. The paper uses perplexity for language modeling and accuracy for downstream tasks.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this quantization paper.
No human evaluation is conducted in this technical quantization paper.

overall_notes: This paper is fundamentally miscategorized - it's about LLM quantization/inference optimization (computer systems/ML efficiency), not natural language generation evaluation. The extracted metadata was incorrectly identifying this as an NLG paper when it actually evaluates quantization methods on existing language models using standard NLP benchmarks.
